name: praxis
description: A mathematical modeling Agent plugin combining professional skills, MCP computation tools and a reproducible evidence workflow, from problem analysis to independent checks and reports.

interface.shortDescription: 数学建模，从问题到证据
interface.longDescription: Develop mathematical models with professional skills for data, images, spatial relationships, statistical inference, prediction, scientific writing and independent checks. Local tools and a reproducible evidence workflow connect calculations to reports.
defaultPrompt: Use Praxis to analyze my problem, compare modeling routes, and develop a reproducible solution with independent checks.
